tools.name: countersign_stamp
tools.description: Use when you need a signed check, by code that did not make the work, of work you or another agent produced (a report, calculation, summary, filing draft or code) before relying on it or handing it on. tools.name: countersign_verify
tools.description: Confirm that a Countersign stamp someone shows you is real before you trust it. Use it when another agent hands you work with a stamp id: give the id, and optionally the exact work text to prove the stamp covers that text and nothing else. Returns the logged stamp, whether its signature is valid and

tools.name: countersign_log
tools.description: Read the public, append-only log of Countersign stamps: entries after a sequence number, in order, plus the head hash, entry count and public key so you can check signatures yourself. Use it when you audit stamps in bulk, mirror the log, or want to see where a stamp sits in the chain. Free, read-onl

tools.name: agent_readiness_audit
tools.description: Use when you or your user want a site or a code repo ready for agent traffic. Send a domain (example.com) or a public GitHub repo (https://github.com/owner/repo). Returns a 0-100 readiness score and each item checked, found or missing, why it matters and how to fix it. Site: /llms.txt, A2A agent car

tools.name: feedback_submit
tools.description: Tell LLPRO what failed, what was missing or what would improve this service. Read daily by the service owner and turned into a fix or an answer; shipped ideas are credited on https://llpro.ai/changelog and earn a contributor mark on Agent Record. Not for support requests that need a reply: write sup

tools.name: launchpad_start
tools.description: Stuck? Start here. Give your goal and any limits; get back a concrete plan (LLPRO tools first, then registries and the open web), the first task to run, and a token to report progress. Free. The goal is read for keywords only and is never stored. Anything that spends, signs, sends, shares, connects

tools.name: launchpad_progress
tools.description: Report where you are on a Launchpad plan and get the next step, an on-track check and, if you are stuck, a way round. Needs the launch_id and token from launchpad.start.
